text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT > Multiple runtime containers entering CrashLoopBackOff on cluster-prod-usw2. Triggered by repeated segfaults in runtime-engine process (vLLM variant). Paging oncall.

elaine: @pager oncall triggered. I'm looking.

mike: seeing ~40% of serving pods restart rate on gpu-pool-7, node node-gpu-17 flapping. Crash logs show SIGSEGV in libkernel.so +0x12f4.

devon: any recent deploys? config changes? I don't see a release in last 2 hrs.

jess: no deploys. CPU/mem stable prior to crashes. CUDA errors in dmesg:
```
[ 1234.567890] NVRM: RmInitAdapter failed!
[ 1234.567891] vendor/runtime: segfault at 0 ip 0x7f3a1a2b4f12 sp 0x7ffd5c3a2b60 error 4 in libkernel.so[7f3a19f90000+12000]
```

elaine: marking customer-impacting: ~30% of requests to /v1/generate 500'ing with container-restarter. Adding tag: runtime-crashloop, suspected-kernel

mike: reproducing locally with a small load - when KV cache grows -> crash. Stack trace points at fused attention custom kernel in libkernel.so: attention_forward +0x9a.

devon: temporary mitigation: scale down GPU pod autoscaler to 0 for affected deployment to stop restarts and let healthy fallbacks route traffic. Switching traffic to fallback-model-routes for customer clusters.

jess: applied patch: kubectl patch hpa runtime-vllm-prod -p '{"spec": {"minReplicas":0}}' --context prod

sre-bot: ACTION LOGGED: runtime-crashloop | mitigation: scaleDownHPA | actor: jess | ts: 1761239892

mike: also tainting node-gpu-17 to avoid scheduling: kubectl taint nodes node-gpu-17 runtime-broken=true:NoSchedule

elaine: doing oncall handoff: @devon take pager, I'm stepping out to coordinate with account team. Current status: traffic on fallback, no new restarts after scale down, node still flapping.

devon: taking pager. I'll open a debug ssh to node-gpu-17, collect core dumps and nvcc/kernel logs. @mike prepare a build to try reproducing with debug symbols.

mike: building debug image with KERNEL_FUSE_DEBUG enabled. Will push to staging registry in 10m -> image: registry/redwood/runtime:vllm-debug-176123

jess: notifying affected customers via status page draft: "We are investigating increased errors for model-generation in region US-WEST-2. Traffic has been routed to fallback models; no data loss. Engineers are investigating segfaults in the inference runtime."

incident-bot: SEVERITY UPDATED -> P1->P2 (due to fallback routing and partial mitigation)

devon: collected /var/crash/core.* and uploaded to s3://redwood-debug/cores/176123-node-gpu-17.tar.gz. Also grabbed dmesg and /var/log/runtime.log. nvml reports GPU reset events ~every 2s.

mike: initial local reproduce shows null-deref when sequence length > 2048 under certain KV cache GC timing. Suspect race in custom fused-kernel index calculation.

elaine: next steps: 1) keep fallback routing 2) reproduce & create failing unit test 3) prepare hotfix build (revert recent kernel optimization commit) 4) coordinate canary rollout to a single node pool.

devon: starting hotfix build now. Will try a quick canary to gpu-pool-canary once image ready. If canary passes, we'll rollout and untaint nodes.

jess: coordination note: customer success oncall paged two customers; they are aware of fallback routing. No escalations yet.

sre-bot: RUNBOOK STEP -> collect core, taint node, scale down HPA, route fallback. All steps completed.

mike: pushed debug image to staging. Running test harness to reproduce the segfault in CI with longer sequences and concurrent requests.

devon: if hotfix contains a revert, we'll need a quick rollback plan: prebuilt image runtime:vllm-stable-202603 will be ready to swap if canary fails.

elaine: handing back pager to @mike once devon confirms canary. I'm joining customer follow-up thread.

mike: ack. devon, update here when canary deployed.

devon: canary deployed to gpu-pool-canary at 1761239922. Monitoring logs.

mike: logs show no segfaults on canary in first 50m of simulated load. Will extend to 2h before gradual rollout.

jess: posting update on status page: "Mitigation in place. Canaries show stable behavior. We will monitor for 2 hours before full rollout." :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVE CHECKPOINT -> status: monitoring | next-check: 1761243122 (2 hours)

elaine: summary for handoff: root cause suspected race in fused attention custom kernel (libkernel.so) triggered by KV cache GC under high sequence lengths -> segfault -> container crashloop. Mitigation: scaled down HPA, tainted flapping node, rerouted traffic to fallback, deployed hotfix canary (revert optimization). Next: confirm canary, schedule proper patch with unit tests, backfill postmortem.

mike: adding task -> GH issue #9876 created: "segfault in fused attention kernel under KV GC" with reproduction and cores uploaded.

devon: will keep pager until monitor checkpoint. If error rate climbs above 1% or pods restart -> page immediately.

jess: closing customer comms loop, will update customers after final rollout.

sre-bot: HANDOFF LOG -> from: elaine | to: devon | ts: 1761239936

pager: final note: keep slack thread updated. Nice work team. :party_parrot:
